title: Possessives 6: Mixed Review
description: Synthesis of all five lessons. The possessives мой / твой and наш / ваш, the invariant trio (его / её / их), demonstratives (этот / тот), and full agreement chains.
descriptionRussian: Синтез пяти уроков. Притяжательные 'мой / твой' и 'наш / ваш', неизменяемая тройка 'его / её / их', указательные 'этот / тот' и полные цепочки.
intro: One reflex covers this whole book: find the noun, read its gender and number, then work leftwards through everything in front of it. Every form you have learned here is either an application of that or one of the three words that ignore it entirely. Nothing today is labeled, so you have to spot which is which.
rules: Мой and твой are built on the stems мо- and тво- plus four endings: -й (m sg), -я (f sg), -ё (n sg), -и (pl).
Наш and ваш have four forms: наш / наша / наше / наши and ваш / ваша / ваше / ваши. The masculine has no vowel ending.
The invariant trio (его, её, их) does not change form. Pick by the owner, not the owned noun.

Demonstratives (этот / тот series) agree with the noun: этот / эта / это / эти (plural -и) and тот / та / то / те (plural -е). In both series the masculine is the base form (этот, тот); the plural ending letter differs but each plural form covers all three genders.
In a chain (demonstrative + possessive + adjective + noun), every layer agrees with the noun, except the invariant trio which stays the same.
examples: Это мой брат. (This is my brother.) The мой / твой series, masculine singular ending -й on the stem мо-: мой.
Это наша школа. (This is our school.) The наш / ваш series, feminine singular ending -а: наша.
Это её книга. (This is her book.) Invariant trio: её does not bend to feminine книга.
Этот дом старый. (This house is old.) Demonstrative этот series, masculine singular form: этот.
Эта моя старая школа. (This is my old school.) Full chain: demonstrative эта, possessive моя, adjective старая, noun школа: all feminine singular.
У меня его новая машина. (I have his new car.) Mixed: invariant его plus agreeing новая plus feminine машина.

tables.title: The Four Families at a Glance

rows.label: мой / твой series
cells: мой / моя / моё / мои; твой / твоя / твоё / твои

rows.label: наш / ваш series
cells: наш / наша / наше / наши; ваш / ваша / ваше / ваши

rows.label: demonstratives
cells: этот / эта / это / эти; тот / та / то / те

items.promptEnglish: Recap from Lesson 5: this is our old house.
items.hint: Дом is masculine singular and the chain has старый as masculine. Match the possessive.
items.explanation: Recap from Lesson 5. Дом is masculine singular. The наш / ваш series gives наш for masculine. Notice how the adjective старый and the possessive наш travel together inside the chain.

items.hint: Телефон is masculine singular. Pick the matching form of the 'your-informal' series from Lesson 1.
items.explanation: Телефон is masculine singular. The твой series gives твой for masculine: the stem тво- plus the masculine ending -й. The form sits in the slot you drilled on Lesson 1.

items.hint: Работа ends in -а: feminine singular. Pick the matching form of the 'our' series.
items.explanation: Работа is feminine singular. The наш / ваш series gives наша: наш plus the feminine -а. Same shape for the parallel ваша in the polite-or-plural slot.

items.promptEnglish: This is Masha. This is her book.
items.hint: The owner is female ('her'). Книга is feminine, but the form does not bend.
items.explanation: Книга is feminine singular, but её is invariant (Lesson 3). The form stays её regardless of the noun; the owner (Masha, 'she') is what picks it.

items.prompt: Это Дима и Анна. Это _____ дети.
items.promptEnglish: This is Dima and Anna. These are their children.
items.hint: The owners are 'they'. Plural дети does not affect the form.
items.explanation: Их is invariant (Lesson 3). It stays the same with any noun. The plural дети is not what triggers the form here: the OWNER is 'they', so the answer is их.

items.hint: Парк is masculine singular. Use the masculine form of the этот series.
items.explanation: Парк is masculine singular. The этот series gives этот for masculine. The predicate adjective красивый already signals masculine in the chain, and the demonstrative matches.

fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Улица is feminine singular. The этот series gives эта for feminine, parallel to the adjective красивая already in the sentence.

sentenceBuilding.hint: Квартира is feminine singular. Both the possessive and the adjective take feminine endings.
Дети is plural. The тот series gives те for plural, and the adjective хорошие matches.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: I live here. This is my house.
minimalPairs.explanation: «Я здесь живу» tells you the speaker owns the house, so 'my' picks мой. Его would mean 'his'. The choice is between owners, not between agreements.
Окно is neuter singular. The demonstrative это agrees: -о ending. Эта would only fit a feminine noun like улица. The predicate adjective большое already signals neuter.

reviewVocab.definition: rule recognition (naming which family of forms produced a given possessive or demonstrative)
reviewVocab.example: Ученик видит форму 'наша' и узнаёт правило: это ряд 'наш / наша / наше / наши'.

reviewVocab.definition: family of forms (one of the four groups: мой / твой, наш / ваш, the invariant trio, or the demonstratives)
reviewVocab.example: Слова 'мой' и 'твой' принадлежат к одной семье форм: мой / моя / моё / мои и твой / твоя / твоё / твои.

reviewVocab.definition: agreement chain (a sequence of modifiers all carrying the same gender and number signal as the noun, with the invariant trio as the one exception)
reviewVocab.example: В цепочке 'эта моя старая школа' все слова стоят в женском роде, но в цепочке 'её старая школа' местоимение 'её' остаётся неизменным.
